label: champ_0020_rival_02
text: Came to see this Gym, huh? That can only mean\none thing...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0020_rival_03
text: You’re out to earn some Gym Badges and take\non the Pokémon League, aren’t you?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0020_rival_04
text: Yesss! I knew it! I’m so glad I asked you to do it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0020_rival_05
text: Yeah, sure you’re not! Just came to the Gym for\nsome sight-seeing, right? Hah! You fibber![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0020_rival_06
text: Before you can battle the Gym Leader, you’ve\ngotta pass a certain challenge set by them—\r\ntheir Gym Test.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0020_rival_07
text: Every Gym’s test is different. If you ask the lobby\nstaff about it, they’ll tell you what’s up![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0020_rival_11
text: Here, have these! When you use ’em, consider it\nme healing up your Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0020_rival_08
text: Ahhh, I’m so glad you’re aiming to be a\nChampion, too! This is the best news ever![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0020_rival_09
text: Man, I’m so excited, I can barely stand still...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0020_rival_10
text: Guess I’ll just go battle every Trainer I run into![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
